title: Add Open Functionality to Sketchpad for Synchronized Kits
description: Add Open functionality to the sketchpad to open synchronized kits. Implement different folder kinds: file kit opens a file picker, folder kit opens a folder picker, remote kit asks for a URL that connects to semio/server. Some folder kinds are only available in native environments such as semio/desktop. Make sure everything is tested end-to-end. Extend semio if necessary.
summary: Fixed synchronized-kit open flows across desktop and sketchpad for JSON-file, folder, and remote session kits. Added Electron file JSON bridge, corrected binary file reads for embedded models, hydrated full remote snapshots, translated nested piece/connection diffs to server commands, extended server snapshot/patch handling, hardened the JS export harness against transient tool-process failures, and added end-to-end coverage for desktop open flows plus server snapshot/piece roundtrip.
